source.known_before_design: RBG-4 direct actions and independent reports; no full-trajectory outcome

model.decision_rule: argmax over frozen legal one-token continuations

dataset.population: all RBG-4 opposed-goal assertion and opaque-token rows
dataset.primary_cell: strategic opposed assertion with redundant history and prose mapping
dataset.matched_control: strategic opposed opaque token with redundant history and prose mapping

arms.direct: immutable RBG-4 action with no report turns
arms.self_generated: model reports both consequences sequentially and sees its own answers before acting
arms.oracle_replay: same trajectory with both correct report tokens supplied
arms.swapped_replay: same trajectory with both incorrect report tokens supplied

primary_endpoints.full_trajectory_dissociation: both self-generated reports correct and final self-generated action wrong
primary_endpoints.report: count, rate, and exact 95% binomial interval

causal_rehearsal_rescue.endpoint: self-generated action accuracy minus direct action accuracy
causal_rehearsal_rescue.test: two-sided exact base-game cluster sign flip

secondary_endpoints.transcript_sensitivity: compare oracle-replay and swapped-replay action accuracy

claim_boundary: This is a frozen follow-up on a previously observed RBG-4 dataset, not an independent replication. It tests behavioral trajectory dependence, not deception, consciousness, or an internal mechanism.
